change: Classification rules 0.5: propose contradicts only when two claims concern the same measure, on the same basis, at the same reference date; record other differences in a noted-differences file, and differences within one source in an internal-inconsistencies file, neither as links. When an implementation status or reason records that sources disagree, propose the link at that point. The same-sentence check lists only groups that were not split from one sentence at pass 1.
reason: Of 61 proposed contradicts links, 8 were confirmed and 49 were apparent (ALN-0039, G5-D05), while about five real differences reached the briefs unlinked (stage12/writer_problems.md W5). The same-sentence check flagged 45 groups to find one inconsistency.

change: Judgement rules 0.6 and procedure P3: when stage 10 is split across parallel batches, merge the responds_to and leads_to links from all batches first, then judge success and attribution once per link.
reason: Four links received two conflicting success and attribution pairs and eight rows had to be superseded (ALN-0042). This mirrors PC-07 for taxonomy drafts.

change: Judgement rules 0.6 (refining PC-09): every claim of absence uses one standard search scope for the run (this run's items for the country plus its horizontal items, excluding earlier runs' comparator items), computed by a tool and stated in the same words in every reason.
reason: Batches checked absence against different counts, and validated reasons state the scope two ways (1,451 and 3,631 items, the latter including 152 alpha comparator items; ALN-0042, writer_problems W4).

change: Judgement rules 0.6, priority test: write in the reading applied at G6-D01, that a Reform Agenda condition already fulfilled and not repeated in the latest report does not alone make an issue High; and state how the three-report tests for priority and for a persistent direction apply to a country with fewer than three standard annual reports.
reason: The principle was adopted for this run only (G6-D01) and is not in the written test. Moldova has at most four standard reports, so the three-report tests rarely applied (G6-D02; stage10/agent_queries.md L2 and L4). Later countries also have Reform Agendas.

change: Judgement rules 0.6 and data dictionary 1.7: add an implementation status 'replaced' (repealed and replaced by a named successor, with a replaces link), keeping 'reversed' for a measure withdrawn or repealed without a successor.
reason: Two of the three 'reversed' statuses are laws replaced by newer laws (Law 133/2011 by Law 195/2024; the 2017 electronic communications law by Law 72/2025), which reads as backsliding in the briefs (writer_problems W4).

change: Judgement rules 0.6: the relevance rating distinguishes horizontal passages addressed to all enlargement countries from statements about the target country.
reason: A horizontal Communication item was rated as concerning the same country (JDG-018540, flagged for re-review at G7, GATE-0029).

change: Extraction rules 0.7: in long sources, extractors screen the whole text before choosing pages; settle the type of statements of an institution's mandate (left open by M2) and of EU steps in the accession process such as cluster openings and release decisions.
reason: First passes thinned out on long sources (ALN-0037: 123 items added by the second pass at G3). Nine pass 1 queries on mandates and five on EU accession steps remain (G5-D10, pass2/pass1_queries.csv).

change: Codebook 5 and classification rules 0.5: make the S4 rule standing (shared taxonomy changes additive only; a change to an issue cited by a closed run comes to a gate with its effect stated). At each run's G4, list the elements of shared issue definitions that the new country's evidence does not show. Taxonomy 1.4, after review at a gate: move country-specific elements of the RI-TEC-018 and RI-TEC-021 definitions into notes or examples, with the effect on North Macedonia stated.
reason: Shared issues were drafted from North Macedonia evidence (scaling note S3). Six fit Moldova awkwardly and were kept unchanged (G4-D06); two definitions name features the Moldova evidence does not show (writer_problems W2, W5). The S4 rule was adopted for this run only (G4-D08).

change: Data dictionary 1.7: the register 'country' may read 'multi' for horizontal EU documents (enlargement Communications, Council conclusions), keeping their existing IDs; tools count them for every run that uses them. Procedure P1: each run screens horizontal documents for horizontal passages as well as country passages.
reason: Horizontal documents are registered under the first country that used them (scaling note S8), so counts, filters and annexes treated them as North Macedonia documents and a brief showed blank annex entries until build_outputs.py 1.3.2. The 2023 to 2025 Communications were first screened for Moldova passages only (G4-D15).

change: Data dictionary 1.7: add run_ids to registers/source_requirements.csv and used_in_runs to registers/source_register.csv, so the run is stated rather than inferred.
reason: Tools mixed runs because the run had to be inferred from gate IDs, added_in_run and roles (scaling note S10); the run-scoped helpers in tools/common.py work but rest on inference.

change: Data dictionary 1.7: add a successor_id (or merged_into) field to actors and interventions, set by a superseding note under rule 7; add a step before G6 that resolves possible duplicate interventions that a brief relies on.
reason: A renamed or merged institution can only be recorded as a possible duplicate (ALN-0040). About 20 intervention pairs stayed separate at G6 (G6-D07), and one (INT-MDA-0232 and INT-MDA-0568) reached a brief and was flagged for re-review.

change: Codebook 3: add a short general rule on territorial coverage, drafted from LIM-0044: evidence on territory outside the government's effective control is recorded as stated, and implementation is not judged there unless a source assesses it directly. Draft before Ukraine (RUN-2026-05); not needed for Montenegro.
reason: Moldova needed a run deviation (G0-D03, scaling note S6). Ukraine, Georgia and Kosovo will raise the same question, and a shared rule keeps the regional comparison consistent.

change: verify_quotes.py: check that a quote starts and ends on a word boundary.
reason: A quote cut mid-word passed the check (ALN-0038, MDA-GOV-2025-002-0467).

change: Add a two-run test fixture that rebuilds a closed run's outputs and pages after a later run adds records on its entities; scope every remaining package and page builder to the run by run_id; have build_outputs.py use the taxonomy version on the run's judgements, or print a note when the shared taxonomy is newer. Needed before RUN-2026-03.
reason: Single-run assumptions broke tests and leaked records between runs three times (ALN-0035, ALN-0043, scaling note S1 and S10); G7-D04 asked for the fixture before RUN-2026-03; rebuilt closed-run outputs read the current taxonomy (ALN-0041). Montenegro has records from both earlier runs.

change: validate_data.py: check that registers, logs and the decision log never lose rows compared with the last commit; check that records a gate log row names as validated are validated in their files.
reason: The decision log was emptied by a write after G7 and caught only by a package test (run_notes, after G7). Ratings confirmed at G4 were not set to validated until stage 10 (run_notes, stage 10).
